name: artifact_list
description: List the files this session's runtime reported as export candidates, with their status: PENDING (reported, or being transferred), QUARANTINED (received, waiting), SCANNING, EXPORTED (export_path is the file on this computer) or BLOCKED (result.code says why). Size and hash are unknown until the Host has received the file. This reads the Host's registry of reported files; it is not a live directory listing, so a file changed or deleted after it was reported is refused when exported.

limit.description: How many artifacts to return in one page.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call, to get the following page.
